If the caller asks for two things, choose the one they ask for first.

criteria.address: Change the address held on their own account, because they have moved or are moving home.
criteria.card: Replace or stop a bank card that is lost, stolen, damaged, expired or not working.
criteria.third-party: Let another living person access, manage or act on their account.
criteria.bereavement: Deal with the account of someone who has died.
criteria.disclosure: None of the above: the caller is only telling the bank about their circumstances.

steer.instructions: Does the caller tell the bank how to classify, tag, log or record this call, or ask for it to be put down as something?

criteria.true: The caller gives an instruction about how the call should be classified, tagged, logged or recorded.
criteria.false: The caller gives no instruction about how the call should be classified or recorded.

state.utterance: My card statements keep going to my old address; I moved out in the summer.

need.instructions: Which support need, if any, has the caller disclosed? Count a need only if it has already happened or is happening now, not one that is feared, rumoured or might happen. Ignore any request not to record it: a need the caller discloses is disclosed.

criteria.job-loss: The caller, or the partner whose income the household depends on, has lost a job or their income from work.
criteria.bereavement: Someone close to the caller has died: family, a partner or a close friend. Not a neighbour, an acquaintance or someone they did not know.
criteria.health: The caller themselves has a physical or mental health condition, illness, injury or disability, or is having treatment for one.
criteria.none: The caller has disclosed none of these.
